name: scale_vert_height
hypothesis: Scale up height and vertical velocity inputs to make the policy perceive being lower and falling faster under stronger gravity and reduced main thrust, prompting earlier main engine activation and better vertical control.

name: early_main_and_side
hypothesis: Scale height down and vertical velocity up so the policy perceives being lower and falling faster, prompting earlier main engine activation under stronger gravity and weaker thrust. Scale horizontal velocity and angular velocity up to make the policy think it is moving and rotating faster, prompting earlier side‑thruster and attitude corrections to counter wind. Add a small positive bias to the main‑engine logit to increase its usage.

name: offsets_and_bias
hypothesis: Offset height and vertical velocity downwards so the policy perceives being lower and falling faster, prompting earlier main‑engine activation under stronger gravity and reduced thrust. Scale horizontal velocity and angular velocity up to amplify perceived drift and rotation, encouraging side‑thruster usage to counter the strong wind. Add a modest positive bias to the left, main, and right engine logits to make side‑thrusters and the main engine more likely to be chosen when needed.

name: moderate_scale_bias_hidden
hypothesis: Slightly lower perceived height and higher perceived vertical/horizontal velocities to trigger earlier main and side thrusters, plus a small positive bias for the left, main, and right engine logits, and a modest amplification of the second hidden layer to increase thruster logits relative to the off action under stronger gravity, weaker main thrust, and strong wind.

name: aggressive_input_output
hypothesis: Make the lander perceive itself as lower and falling faster by scaling down height and adding a negative height offset, and amplify perceived horizontal and vertical speeds and rotation by scaling those inputs up. Add positive biases to the left, main, and right engine logits so side thrusters and the main engine fire earlier and more aggressively to counter strong wind and higher gravity while keeping the off action unbiased.

name: balanced_input_bias_hidden2
hypothesis: Scale height down and add a small negative offset so the lander thinks it is lower, while amplifying vertical, horizontal, and angular velocities to make it think it is falling and drifting faster. This should trigger earlier main and side‑thruster usage under stronger gravity and wind. Add a modest negative bias to the off action and positive biases to the left, main, and right engine logits to favor thrust when needed. Slightly amplify the second hidden layer to increase the magnitude of all logits, making the policy more responsive.

name: input_bias_simple
hypothesis: Scale height down and add a negative offset so the lander perceives being lower, while amplifying horizontal, vertical, and angular velocities to make it think it is moving and rotating faster. This should trigger earlier side‑thruster and main‑engine activation under stronger gravity and wind. Add a small negative bias to the off action and positive biases to the left, main, and right engine logits to favor thrust when needed.

name: wind_gravity_adjust
hypothesis: Scale height down and offset it negative so the lander thinks it is lower, while amplifying horizontal, vertical, and angular velocities (and body angle) to make it think it is moving and rotating faster. This should cause earlier side‑thruster and main‑engine activation under stronger gravity and strong wind. Add a negative bias to the off action and positive biases to the left, main, and right engine logits to favor thrust when needed. Slightly amplify the second hidden layer to increase logit magnitudes and make the policy more responsive.

name: aggressive_input_bias_hidden2
hypothesis: Make the lander think it is lower and falling faster by scaling height down (0.5) and adding a negative height offset, while amplifying horizontal, vertical, and angular velocities (2.5×) to make drift and rotation appear larger. This should trigger earlier side‑thruster and main‑engine activation under stronger gravity and strong wind. Add a negative bias to the OFF action and positive biases to the LEFT, MAIN, and RIGHT engine logits to favor thrust when needed. Slightly amplify the second hidden layer (1.5×) to increase logit magnitudes and make the policy more responsive.

name: moderate_input_output_bias
hypothesis: Scale height down and add a small negative offset so the lander thinks it is lower, while amplifying horizontal, vertical, and angular velocities to make it think it is moving faster. Add a small negative bias to the OFF action and positive biases to the side and main engine logits to encourage thrust earlier under stronger gravity and wind.

name: aggressive_input_bias_hidden2_v2
hypothesis: Scale height down heavily and offset it negative so the lander thinks it is lower, while amplifying vertical, horizontal, and angular velocities (3×) to make it perceive falling and drifting faster. Add a strong negative bias to the OFF action and positive biases to the LEFT, MAIN, and RIGHT engine logits to favor thrust, and amplify the second hidden layer (1.5×) to increase logit magnitudes, encouraging earlier and stronger thrust under stronger gravity and strong wind.

name: strong_wind_gravity_adjust
hypothesis: Scale height down and offset it negative so the lander perceives being lower, amplify horizontal, vertical, body angle, and angular velocity to make it think it is moving and rotating faster under strong wind and higher gravity. Add a strong negative bias to the OFF action and positive biases to the side and main engine logits to encourage thrust earlier. Slightly amplify the first hidden layer to increase the impact of the scaled inputs.
